answers.question: current maker commission / rebate mechanics
answers.answer: Makers pay no commission. Maker rebate = round_half_even(0.0125 * C * p * (1-p), $0.01), Theta = -0.0125, max rebate $0.31 per 100 contracts at p=0.50, credited at fill time, banker's rounding to the cent, effective exchange-wide from 12 AM ET Wed 2026-07-01.

answers.question: programs that exist today
answers.answer: Open: Deposit Incentive, Refer-A-Friend, Volume Incentive (taker), Liquidity Incentive (resting orders). Coming Soon: Daily Trading Incentive, Deposit and Trading Incentive. Application: Market Maker Program, Referral Incentive. Plus the exchange-wide maker rebate as a fee-schedule term.
answers.source: data/pmus/sports_incentives_2026-09-10/doc_incentives_overview.md (verbatim docs.polymarket.us/incentives/overview); still the live set per 2026-10-07 search

answers.question: eligibility criteria
answers.answer: Maker rebate: no enrolment, any passive fill, whole quotable price band 0.01-0.99, NO 0.20-0.80 band (that band is Gemini's). Liquidity Incentive: Open, no signup, but a side only qualifies if aggregate resting size reaches Target Size and the exchange walks from best price outward - if Target Size is reached before your level you score zero. Volume Incentive: taker-side notional only, trades between 3c and 97c inclusive, $500 notional minimum in the published NBA instance - unreachable for us because we are maker-only. Market Maker Program: application, contractual, never applied for. Daily Trading / Deposit+Trading: Coming Soon, unavailable.
answers.source: doc_incentives_liquidity.md; doc_incentives_volume.md; REBATE_APPLICABILITY_1.md (for the Gemini band distinction)

answers.question: calculation formula
answers.answer: Maker rebate 0.0125*C*p*(1-p) cent-rounded; as a rate of maker notional this equals 0.0125*(1-p) = 87.5 bps at p=0.30, 75.0 at 0.40, 62.5 at 0.50, 50.0 at 0.60, 37.5 at 0.70, absolute ceiling 125 bps as p->0. Liquidity Incentive: Score = DiscountFactor^(ticks from best) * OrderSize, random 1-second book snapshots, each side independently normalized to 1.0 per snapshot provided Target Size is met; derived payout = Pool * X/(X+D) * duty / (2M). Volume Incentive: your share of total eligible taker notional times the pool.

answers.question: caps and tiers
answers.answer: Maker rebate: max $0.31 per 100 contracts; hard per-fill cent floor - raw below $0.005 pays $0.00 (OBSERVED on 6 of our prints); no tiers, no volume ladder, no 30-day notional tier. Liquidity Incentive: no per-person cap ('purely proportional to your share of the total score') but rewards under $1.00 are not paid out; Target Size is a gate not a cap. Volume Incentive: pool-capped per contract, $500 notional minimum in the published instance.

answers.question: market / category restrictions
answers.answer: Our primary capture states the schedule 'applies symmetrically across all contract types' with NO per-category variation - sports, crypto and politics charged and rebated identically. CONFLICT: 2026-10-07 third-party pages assert per-category taker thetas on PMUS (tech/mentions 0.04, sports 0.05, politics ~0.04, crypto 0.07; maxima $1.00-$1.75 per 100 shares) and separately quote a '20%/25% of matched taker fee' maker rebate split by category - the latter is Polymarket INTERNATIONAL's Maker Rebates Program (help.polymarket.com/articles/13364471), a different venue, and is not imported. answers.question: does BTC15m (series btc-updown-15m) qualify
answers.answer: MAKER REBATE: YES - exchange-wide, no category carve-out, no enrolment; a BTC15m maker fill earns 0.0125*C*p*(1-p) cent-floored. LIQUIDITY INCENTIVE: no active program found. Nearest direct evidence is reward_state.json - every up/down series (BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/HYPE/BNB/DOGE at 5m/15m/4h) reads reward_state EXPIRED, rewards_daily_rate null, in_sampling_rewards_list false, and sampling_markets_containing_updown 0 of a 17562-market sweep - BUT that artifact is venue polymarket_international, not PMUS. PMUS-side evidence is weaker and points the same way: our_traded_slugs_programs.json returns with_programs 0 for all 239 slugs we have traded/observed/ranked, and published_programs_covering_our_markets = 0 in all five audits. VOLUME INCENTIVE: NO, structurally - maker-only means zero taker notional.

answers.question: do sports or other PMUS categories qualify differently
answers.answer: Yes, and the entire difference is in the liquidity program, not the rebate. Sports liquidity programs are ACTIVE and large; crypto up/down liquidity rewards are expired/absent. Measured at our working size of 12 contracts against real books (61 programs, 2026-09-10T17:29Z): nfl_player_props_live_20260902 pool $28,500 / 1314 markets -> $10.40 at 100% duty; nfl_period_spreads_live_20260904 $5.55; nfl_period_spreads_day_of $2.77; nfl_props_early $2.70; cfb_t2_ml_live $2.27; ufc_prelim_moneyline_live $1.41. 6 of 46 clear the $1.00 minimum at 100% duty; 40 do not clear it at all so their correct expected value is exactly $0.00. These are ESTIMATES and upper bounds (depth sampled Thursday afternoon for Sunday live pools; our duty cycle is near zero by design at maker_rest_max_s 5.0 and one outstanding order; the 1/(2M) term punishes one-market-at-a-time).

answers.question: payout timing and mechanism
answers.answer: Maker rebate: credited at fill time as a negative commissionNotionalCollected on our own execution; immediate, per fill, no minimum beyond cent rounding. Liquidity Incentive: 'calculated within 5 business days of each time period ending and credited to your account within 2 business days of the end of that calculation'; 'Rewards under $1.00 are not paid out'; arrives as ACTIVITY_TYPE_TRANSFER, currency USD, description 'liquidity reward payout', status ACCOUNT_BALANCE_CHANGE_STATUS_COMPLETED, with empty metadata and NO market/order/fill reference - attribution to markets only by matching /v1/incentives/earnings rows. Volume Incentive: pool settlement per contract; never credited to us.

breakeven.verdict_on_97_59_bps: NOT SUFFICIENT AND NOT THE RIGHT LEVER. It is Gemini, not PMUS. Against the PMUS formula it is an ordinary rate, sitting between p=0.30 (87.5 bps) and p=0.20 (100 bps). Raising our rate from the measured 73.9 to 97.59 bps would cut the notional needed for $480/day from $64,953 to $49,185 - a 24% improvement on a requirement we miss by ~8,700x. Rate optimisation cannot close a notional gap of that size. At 73.9 bps a single -$3.90 directional residual costs $528 of maker notional to repay.

sports.verdict: the only lane with program money available to us, BUT it pays for resting breadth across many markets sampled every second - our engine rests ~5s, holds one outstanding order, works one market at a time and chases fills, so duty is ~0 by design and the 1/(2M) term pays a single-market participant 1/2628th of a 1314-market pool; 40 of 46 sampled programs do not clear the $1.00 minimum at 100% duty

venue_recommendation.conclusion: BTC15m is not the wrong venue for incentive capture - on the maker rebate, the only incentive we have ever been credited at scale, it is identical to everywhere else. Sports is the only lane with a second incentive stream, and capturing it would require a different engine (breadth, duty, passive resting that does not want to fill), contradicting the current one-market fill-seeking maker-first spring discipline. Switching category to chase it is a strategy change, not a parameter change, and nothing here authorises it.
